name: Confirm Modal
description: Generic confirmation dialog used for destructive actions (file delete). Renders a message (with HTML sanitization: strips script/img/iframe/embed/object/link/style tags and on* attributes), Cancel and OK/Delete buttons. Pressing Escape triggers Cancel. Returns a Promise<boolean> via open(). Used by FileExplorerPlugin for delete confirmation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Builds modal overlay with sanitized message, Cancel and OK buttons

methods.name: open
methods.description: Displays modal, focuses Cancel, returns true if OK clicked, false on Cancel/Escape/overlay-click
